text:
Mia: Quick sync — CloudMarket asked how we'll handle SKU-level metering for private offers when customers move between Hosted <-> Dedicated mid-term. Need rules for proration, SKU renames, and renewal credits.

Hector: Ops: short answer = prefer immutable SKU per pricing bundle + mapping table that indicates compatible SKUs. If a customer migrates, we issue prorated credit against new SKU, not a rename.

Nina: Finance: need the math and examples for deal desk. Please provide a proration formula and a sample line item.

Olivia: Legal: also need language around "no double-credit" and how we net out credits on renewal. Suggest: credits applied to next invoice within 90 days, expires if unused.

Ben: Sales: field needs an easy rule. Example: migrate in month 4 of 12 -> credit remaining 8/12 * commitment value pro-rated. If moving to a higher tier, charge difference immediately.

Hector: Agree. I'll draft ops flow. Short pseudo example below:

```
Old SKU: sku.redwood.hosted.alpha (12mo $120k)
Customer migrates at month 4 -> unused months = 8 -> credit = (8/12) * $120k = $80k credit toward new SKU
If new SKU annual price = $200k -> apply credit $80k, bill remainder $120k prorated to remaining term or start a new 12mo depending on PO
```

Nina: Finance: prefer normalization to annualized value and allow start-new-term option. Also need per-deal cap: credits cannot exceed 50% of new term value without CFO approval.

Olivia: Legal: add clause: "Credit application and term reset subject to Marketplace listing compatibility and partner approval for co-branded offers." Also set credit expiry 180 days after issue.

Mia: Partner asks for SKU naming convention so partner ops can map. Hector, can you propose a short naming pattern?

Hector: Proposal: sku.<partner>.<deployment>.<band>.<term> e.g., sku.cloudx.dedicated.beta.12m. Keeps it unique and parsable.

Ben: Field asks: what about upgrades mid-term (customer upsizes commit)? Propose immediate reprice and pro-rate old SKU downward, then credit applied to next invoice. Simpler for billing.

Nina: Finance: require approvals logged for mid-term upsizes >25% change. Also require credit audit trail in portal.

partners-bot: Marketplace checklist link: https://marketplace.example/pricing-checklist (contains SKU CSV template + PR flow)

Olivia: Legal will draft PO snippet for proration, credit caps, expiry, and "no double-credit" rule. Will post by EOD.

Hector: Ops will build SKU CSV with sample rows and send to Marketplace team.

Mia: Action items: Hector -> SKU naming + CSV; Nina -> proration table + cap rules; Olivia -> PO snippets; Ben -> field FAQ + quick scripts. Lock wording by Thu EOD so Marketplace can publish Friday.

All: +1
